errors.error_description: Introduced an unreachable FSM state by adding S_UNUSED to the enum without any transitions to or from it.
Assigned a 32-bit write data bus directly to an 8-bit register (last_byte <= req_wdata), causing truncation.
Omitted the semicolon at the end of a localparam declaration line.
Used the 4-state equality operator (===) in synthesizable combinational control logic.
